test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which type of gear applies in a car when the engine is running and the clutch is engaged, and the clutch shaft gear drives the drive gear of the lay shaft and thus lay shaft also rotates and the main shaft remains stationary as no gears in main shaft are engaged with lay shaft gears?
solution:
The correct answer is __Neutral gear**(Option 1)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Neutral gear__ is when no gears on the main shaft are engaged with the lay shaft gears.
 
• In this state, the engine is running, and the clutch is engaged, but the main shaft remains stationary.
 
• The lay shaft rotates as it is driven by the clutch shaft gear.
 
• Neutral gear is essential for starting the engine safely or idling without engaging the drivetrain.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Reverse Gear:**

 
 
• Engages gears to allow the car to move backward.
 
• The direction of rotation of the main shaft is reversed via an idler gear.
 
 
 
• **Top Gear:**
 
 
• The highest gear in the transmission system.
 
• It provides maximum speed with minimum engine effort.
 
 
 
• **First Gear:**
 
 
• Used for maximum torque and minimum speed.
 
• Typically engaged during initial movement of the vehicle.
